plan: Store a private deep copy and use recursive traversal helpers for lookup, aggregation, and rendering.
Use regular expressions to remove note markers before counting words and to collect marker identifiers.
Validate every move, including destination, index, and containment cycles, before mutating any item list.
Return deep copies from to_data() so callers cannot mutate workspace state.
mechanisms: Marker stripping and extraction with compiled regular expressions
Preflight move validation for atomic failure behavior
Deep-copy boundaries at construction and serialization

trace.source_relation: Notes derive word counts from text while references contribute declared word_count values.
Unresolved identifiers originate in note marker tokens and reference unresolved lists.
trace.target_mechanism: Regular-expression marker extraction combined with set-based deduplication and lexical sorting

trace.source_relation: Sections and groups recursively contain items, while notes and references do not.
trace.target_mechanism: Recursive traversal restricted to container kinds

trace.source_relation: A container cannot be moved into itself or one of its descendants.
Every failed move must leave serialized workspace data unchanged.
trace.target_mechanism: Complete preflight validation before pop() and insert()

trace.source_relation: Input and serialized output must not share mutable state with the workspace.
